title: Hastings' Confessions: his own abduction experiences

tellings.quote: he wrote after UFOs and nukes is called confessions and it's about his own his personal experien abduction cases

Of course, as an abductee myself, who has repeatedly experienced the physical reality of these amazing encounters, I am admittedly biased about the prospect of this realization materializing sooner or later, among our species as a whole.

plain: Robert Hastings, a researcher known for gathering stories of UFOs over US nuclear weapons sites, says he has himself been taken by aliens. Michels says that after his book UFOs and Nukes, Hastings wrote another called Confessions, about his own personal abduction experiences. Hastings says so in his own words in an article dated 16 November 2025: 'as an abductee myself, who has repeatedly experienced the physical reality of these amazing encounters, I am admittedly biased.' In that passage he is writing about his hope that humanity as a whole will come to accept these encounters. It matters to the tellers because a leading collector of military witnesses counts himself among the witnesses. The two tellers are Michels, describing the book, and Hastings, speaking for himself in print.
